opportunities.observation: K3 requires about 1.74 TB at canonical c128 and remains HBM-bandwidth bound, so memory capacity and bandwidth dominate the selected system's cost floor.
opportunities.evidence_scope: exact 1.561 TB checkpoint plus analytical 82K cache/state and synthetic c128 resource model
competing_explanations: HBM package cost is lower than assumed
capacity can be tiered into cheaper memory
prefix sharing materially reduces the live cache
opportunities.mechanism: Use twelve modest compute dies with 192 GB / 3 TB/s memory envelopes rather than eight maximum-bandwidth, maximum-compute packages.
opportunities.falsifier: Sourced package, HBM, substrate, board, and yield estimates cannot meet the $260k target or 36 TB/s aggregate envelope at useful yield.
opportunities.next_measurement: Obtain two independent volume quotes or credible bottom-up package/BOM ranges for 2.304 TB installed HBM and 36 TB/s aggregate bandwidth.
opportunities.promotion_rule: P50 all-in manufactured system cost leaves at least 30% margin below the cloud break-even capex after NRE amortization.
opportunities.kill_rule: P20 cost exceeds the break-even capex or the memory topology cannot be built within the power/package envelope.

opportunities.observation: Graphcore demonstrates explicit local SRAM, static tile programs, and BSP exchange at scale, but K3 must continuously stream a 1.45 TB routed-expert bank from external memory.
opportunities.evidence_scope: Graphcore vendor documentation plus exact K3 tensor inventory and synthetic schedule
competing_explanations: global barriers amplify expert imbalance
asynchronous GPU-style issue is required for HBM overlap
local SRAM banking/control erases the logic savings
opportunities.mechanism: Synchronize 48-tile groups locally while independent DMA groups prefetch the next expert wave; use pod-wide epochs only at layer and collective boundaries.
opportunities.falsifier: A routed-trace event simulation loses more than 15% of endpoint time to barriers, tail tiles, or DMA starvation at c32/c128.
opportunities.next_measurement: Replay exact top-16 route traces through a tile-group discrete-event schedule with HBM-bank and barrier timing.

opportunities.observation: The exact K3 decode ledger streams roughly 140 GB/output token at batch one before cache/state traffic, and every initial machine point is HBM-limited.
opportunities.evidence_scope: analytical K3 revision 9f62e4e; text decode; concurrency 1-512
competing_explanations: skinny-matrix compute utilization
fabric serialization
launch/control gaps
cache-state traffic
opportunities.mechanism: Co-designed DMA, 128-row GEMV dataflow, layer-persistent schedules, and fused epilogues raise useful HBM bandwidth.
opportunities.falsifier: An exact K3 B300 trace shows >=70% useful HBM bandwidth or a non-memory critical path at canonical concurrency.
opportunities.next_measurement: Profile exact K3 TP8 at c1/c32/c128 with profiler-off timings and HBM/L2/tensor/launch counters.
opportunities.promotion_rule: Measured useful bandwidth below 50% with memory stalls controlling endpoint time.
opportunities.kill_rule: Measured incumbent utilization leaves less than 25% endpoint headroom.

opportunities.observation: All core K3 projection and expert dimensions are divisible by 128 while decode M is small and prefill M is large.
opportunities.evidence_scope: released config and tensor shapes; decode/prefill mapping
competing_explanations: B300 skinnyGEMM already removes most underfill
weight bandwidth dominates irrespective of dataflow
opportunities.mechanism: Use 128 output-row inner-product lanes for GEMV and reconfigure the same MACs into systolic GEMM for prefill.
opportunities.falsifier: Cycle-accurate RTL or FPGA slice cannot sustain >=70% MAC use at K3 M=1/32/128 without exceeding the SRAM/power envelope.
opportunities.next_measurement: Implement one MXFP4/MXFP8 128x128 tile with K3 3584x3072 and 7168x12288 shapes; measure utilization, SRAM ports, Fmax, and watts.

opportunities.observation: KDA requires about 232 MB recurrent and short-convolution state per live request across 69 layers, independent of context.
opportunities.evidence_scope: analytical state shape 69x96x128x128 BF16 plus convolution state
competing_explanations: weights dominate at low concurrency
MLA cache dominates at long context
state can remain in B300 L2
opportunities.mechanism: Banked explicitly managed SRAM keeps current recurrent/AttnRes state on chip and fuses update/readback.
opportunities.falsifier: Measured KDA state DRAM traffic is below 5% of endpoint HBM bytes or required ports/area exceed the envelope.
opportunities.next_measurement: Trace fused KDA decode state bytes and build an SRAM banking/port model for c1/c32/c128.

opportunities.observation: Layer ownership can eliminate per-layer expert all-to-all but reduces batch reuse and adds autoregressive pipeline latency.
opportunities.evidence_scope: synthetic balanced PP8 and TP2xPP4 K3 decode
competing_explanations: real expert skew increases reuse
many independent sessions hide pipeline bubbles
layer imbalance breaks balance
opportunities.mechanism: Reconfigure between TP8 latency mode and pipeline/hybrid throughput modes.
opportunities.falsifier: A discrete-event schedule with exact routed traces fails to beat TP8 on both throughput and energy at any SLO-admissible concurrency.
opportunities.next_measurement: Replay an exact routed-token trace through TP8, TP2xPP4, and PP8 event schedules.

opportunities.observation: The 1.561 TB checkpoint plus canonical 82K cache/state makes c512 exceed 90% of 8x288 GB HBM.
opportunities.evidence_scope: exact checkpoint bytes plus analytical FP8 MLA/BF16 KDA state
competing_explanations: prefix sharing reduces resident cache
offload expands capacity but adds bandwidth
production contexts are shorter
opportunities.mechanism: Treat HBM capacity and cache tiering as architectural constraints, not an afterthought.
opportunities.falsifier: Exact runtime allocation shows c512 fits with fragmentation headroom at the canonical context without offload.
opportunities.next_measurement: Measure exact vLLM resident bytes/request and prefix-cache sharing under the OpenRouter geometry.
